About Us

Our Story

From a small kitchen to your favorite food destination — this is the story of Al Sheeri's, built on passion, flavor, and love for food.

How It All Began

Al Sheeri's started as a dream in 2020, right here in Sullurpeta. What began as a small food stall serving fresh, homemade dishes quickly grew into the town's most loved food spot.

Our founder believed that great food doesn't need a fancy setting — it needs heart, fresh ingredients, and recipes that tell a story. That belief drives everything we do today.

What We Stand For

🔥

Fresh & Hot

Every order is prepared fresh. No shortcuts, no compromises.

❤️

Made with Love

We cook like we're feeding family — with care and attention.

🚀

Fast Delivery

Hot food at your doorstep within 25-35 minutes.

Meet the Founder

The vision behind Al Sheeri's comes from a deep love for food and community. Our founder's journey from a small kitchen to serving hundreds of happy customers every day is a testament to hard work and dedication.

"Food is not just about taste — it's about the memories you create around a meal."

Our Mission

To serve the best multi-cuisine food in Sullurpeta and surrounding areas, making every meal an experience worth remembering. We're committed to quality, freshness, and making great food accessible to everyone.

Serving: Sullurpeta, Tada, Doravarisatram, Naidupeta
